Warranty

Warranty and care plans for Tuga devices

Every Tuga device comes with 12 months against defects. The 3-Year Warranty makes that three years. For a fleet, Total Care is the whole package: a swap unit the same day for any fault, and cover for accidental damage, theft and loss, with published prices and numbered terms you can send to your finance team.

Included

Standard warranty

With every device

Every Tuga device. 12 months against defects. No extra charge.

What's covered 7 points
  • 12 months from the dispatch date on your invoice against defects in materials and workmanship
  • Repair, or replacement with the same or an equivalent Tuga model, at our choice, at no charge
  • Battery covered against defects for 12 months (normal capacity loss is not a defect)
  • Carriage: business buyers pay to send the device to us and we pay the return carriage after a valid repair or replacement. If you buy as a consumer and the device is faulty, we pay the postage both ways under the Consumer Rights Act 2015
  • Returns: any buyer may return a device in its original condition and packaging within 30 days of delivery. Consumers also may cancel within 14 days of delivery under the Consumer Contracts Regulations 2013 (we may deduct only for handling beyond what is needed to inspect the device) and have 30 days to reject a faulty device under the Consumer Rights Act 2015
  • Email and phone help with set-up on working days, one working day response
  • Return for recycling under the WEEE Regulations 2013 on request

Recommended

3-Year Warranty

From £65 per device

The included warranty, for three years instead of one. Same cover, same terms, one price per device.

What's covered 9 points
  • 36 months from the dispatch date on your invoice against defects in materials and workmanship: the included 12-month warranty, for three years (months 1 to 12 are the included warranty; months 13 to 36 are added by this plan)
  • Repair, or replacement with the same or an equivalent Tuga model, at our choice, at no charge, for an accepted defect. No limit on the number of defect repairs during the term
  • Battery and any built-in scanner covered against defects for the full 36 months (normal capacity loss is not a defect). W8 and W10: a replacement pack is sent to you by road courier to fit. A6, A8, A10 and WH6: we replace the sealed pack in our workshop and test the seal before return
  • The same service as the included warranty: a reply within one working day, and a target of ten working days from receiving the device to sending it back
  • The same carriage as the included warranty: business buyers send the device to us at their cost and we pay the return; if you buy as a consumer and the device is faulty, we pay both ways
  • A repaired or replaced device, or a replaced part, carries the rest of the original term, or 90 days from dispatch of the replacement if that is longer
  • Stays with the device: if you pass it to another user in the UK and tell us, the warranty continues for the rest of the term
  • Cancel within 30 days of purchase for a full refund if you have made no claim (45 days if you buy as a consumer), then at any time for a pro rata refund by full unexpired months
  • Does not cover accidental damage, liquid, theft or loss. Total Care does

Cover

What is covered, and what is not

Every Tuga warranty covers the device failing on its own. Total Care also covers something happening to it. The included warranty covers the first 12 months; the 3-Year Warranty and Total Care cover 36 months from dispatch.

Every warranty: faults that happen on their own

  • A screen or touch panel that stops working without being damaged: dead areas, lines, flicker, touch that stops responding (clause 11)
  • The mainboard, memory and storage: a device that will not start, crashes from a hardware fault or loses its storage (clause 11)
  • Charging ports, buttons, cameras, speakers and microphones that fail in normal use (clause 11)
  • 4G, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, GPS and NFC that stop working because of a hardware fault (clause 11)
  • The built-in barcode scanner on the A6 and on the scanner versions of the W8, W10 and WH6 (clauses 5 and 11)
  • A battery that fails rather than fades: one that will not charge, cuts out or swells (clause 12)
  • Repair, or replacement with the same or an equivalent model, at no charge and with no limit on the number of claims (clause 11)

Total Care also covers: something happening to it

  • Drops, knocks and impacts: a cracked screen, a broken port, a device that will not start after a fall (clause 21A)
  • Crushing: run over, sat on, trapped in a door or a van tail lift (clause 21A)
  • Liquid and water getting in beyond the IP rating, and fire (clause 21A)
  • Theft, with a police crime reference, and loss, reported to us within five working days (clause 21B)
  • Software faults: the operating system, your image or an update stopping the device working (clause 21C)
  • No excess. Fair use: two damage claims per device each contract year, and one theft or loss claim per device over the term (clause 21D)
  • A swap unit dispatched the same working day for every claim accepted by 14:00, and UK carriage both ways (clauses 13 and 21)

Not covered by any plan

  • Damage done on purpose or recklessly, such as throwing the device or using it as a tool
  • A device left unattended in public view, or in an unlocked vehicle or building, that is then stolen
  • Scratches, dents and discolouration that do not stop it working
  • A battery losing capacity with normal age and use (Total Care services batteries at month 18)
  • Worn consumables and accessories: seals, straps, styluses, screen protectors, cases and chargers
  • Your own apps, services and data
  • Opening or repair by anyone we have not authorised, and unapproved chargers
  • Devices outside the United Kingdom

The full list is clauses 11, 17 and 21A to 21D of the Plan Terms. If a device comes in with an excluded fault or no fault, we tell you before we charge anything: either £35 for inspection and return carriage, or a repair quote if you would rather have it fixed (clause 15).

Every Tuga device comes with a 12-month warranty against defects in materials and workmanship. If you want longer, or you run a fleet that cannot wait for a repair, there are two paid plans. All three are given by us, Destello Tech Ltd trading as Tuga Hardware, company number 16595781, registered in England, registered office 124 Vicarage Wood, Harlow, Essex CM20 3HH. Every line in the 3-Year Warranty and Total Care columns below has a matching numbered clause in the Plan Terms (clauses 5 to 43); the included warranty is set out in clauses 44 to 49 of the same Terms and in our Terms of Business, which say the same thing. You can send either document to your finance team.

The 3-Year Warranty is the included warranty for longer: the same cover, the same terms and the same service, for 36 months from dispatch instead of 12. It covers defects in materials and workmanship, including the battery and any built-in scanner, and nothing else. It is available on every Tuga model. One price per device, the same at any quantity: A6 £65, A8 £65, A10 £65, W8 £79, W10 £79, WH6 £89. Scanner versions cost £15 more to cover, because the scan engine is one more part we repair or replace: W8 with 2D Scanner £94, W10 with 2D Scanner £94, WH6 with Barcode Scanner £104.

Total Care is the whole package, for business fleets of five or more devices on any Tuga model, and sole traders count as a business. It covers what the warranties do not: accidental damage (drops, cracked screens, crushing, liquid and fire), theft and loss, and software faults, which we fix by restoring your image. There is no excess; a published fair use limit allows two damage claims per device in each contract year and one theft or loss claim per device over the term. Whatever the claim, if we accept it by 14:00 on a working day, we dispatch a swap unit with your software image on it the same day, for delivery the next working day to addresses on our courier's standard next-day network (we check your sites by postcode when you join; other addresses, including Northern Ireland, the Scottish Highlands and Islands, the Isle of Wight and the Isle of Man, get same-day dispatch and two to five working days in transit). We service the batteries at month 18, hold swap stock for your fleet, lend you a unit for trials, answer the phone, report quarterly, and at the end of life we collect, erase and certify. If we miss the delivery level on a standard-network address we add time to your term, and the Terms say exactly how much. Per device for fleets of 10 or more: A6 £249, A8 £269, A10 £279, W8 £299, W10 £299, WH6 £329. Fleets of 5 to 9 devices pay £30 more per device: A6 £279, A8 £299, A10 £309, W8 £329, W10 £329, WH6 £359. Scanner versions add £15 per device to either band.

The included warranty and the 3-Year Warranty cover defects only. Total Care's cover for damage, theft and loss is provided by us as part of the service, not by an insurer, and no insurer or other third party stands behind any of the plans: the remedy is always our own repair, replacement or service, never a cash payment. Prices are per device and are the amounts payable today; we are not currently VAT registered.

Claims

How a claim works

  1. Check the registerEvery device dispatched with a paid plan is recorded by serial number on our warranty register at dispatch, with the plan, dispatch date and end date. Ask us at any time for the serial, plan and end date we hold for your device. The Terms are at tugahardware.com/warranty-terms. A claim is accepted only for a serial on the register.
  2. Tell usEmail support@tugahardware.com or call us on a working day (08:30 to 17:30) with the serial number (on the back of the device and on your invoice), what the device is doing, what you have tried, and where possible a photo, a short video or a diagnostic report (Windows battery report on the W8, W10 and WH6; our diagnostic app or the battery statistics screen on the A6, A8 and A10). We log the time and give you a claim reference. Under Total Care the nominated site contact logs the claim and gives the delivery address for the swap unit, which must be one listed in your fleet schedule or confirmed by us in writing.
  3. We reply3-Year Warranty: within one working day. Total Care: acknowledgement within two working hours and triage started within four working hours. We work through a published checklist of no more than 20 minutes of your time: power and charger check, forced restart, known-good charger, battery reading, visible damage check. If the fault clears, we close the claim with a note on the register. If the photos show damage (cracked glass, liquid indicators, crushing), under Total Care we log it as a damage claim under clause 21A; under the other warranties we say so now and offer a fixed-price repair quote instead of a warranty claim. This step removes most no-fault-found returns.
  4. AcceptanceWe confirm acceptance by email with the claim number. 3-Year Warranty: we send you our workshop address and the claim number to put in the parcel; business buyers send the device at their cost, and a consumer with a faulty device gets a prepaid label. Total Care: this starts the dispatch clock. If accepted by 14:00 on a working day, the pre-imaged swap unit is booked on the next-working-day courier account with declared value and leaves the same day, with the prepaid return label in the box. A claim accepted after 14:00 counts as accepted at 08:30 the next working day. Log by 12:00 with the checklist completed and you have our decision by 14:00.
  5. The device travels3-Year Warranty: back up your data, remove the SIM and memory card, pack the device in your packaging or our box, and send it to us by a tracked service. We pay the return carriage. Total Care: the swap unit arrives the next working day at addresses on the courier's standard next-day network (listed in your fleet schedule). For other addresses, including Northern Ireland, the Scottish Highlands and Islands, the Isle of Wight and the Isle of Man, it leaves the same day on the fastest available service and typically arrives in two to five working days. Put the faulty or damaged device in the swap box, apply the prepaid label and send it back within ten working days. After a theft or loss there is nothing to send back.
  6. InspectionWithin two working days of receiving a device we inspect it, record the finding on the RMA log (defect confirmed, no fault found, excluded damage) and tell you the outcome, the action and the expected dispatch date. Workshop rule: repair when parts plus labour are under half the cost of a replacement device, which covers screens, battery packs, ports, buttons and speakers; replace for mainboard faults and liquid ingress.
  7. Repair or replace3-Year Warranty: we repair or replace and dispatch by tracked next-day carrier, target ten working days from receipt, as for the included warranty. We tell you which we did and why. Total Care: the swap unit already with you becomes the covered device; the returned device is repaired, re-imaged and goes back into the swap pool, or is scrapped and replaced in the pool from new stock. For a battery job on any model except the W8 and W10 we replace the pack, refit the seals and run a leak test before the unit is used again.
  8. Battery faultsA battery that fails through a defect (it will not hold or take a charge, it swells, or it loses capacity far faster than normal ageing explains) is handled like any other claim, under either paid plan. Send us the device's battery reading and we confirm it in our workshop with three readings across three full charge cycles. W8 and W10: we send a new pack with fitting instructions by road courier under our carrier's dangerous-goods acceptance; you fit it in under a minute and take the old pack to a local battery recycling point, or keep it for collection with the device at end of life. We never ask you to post a battery back. A6, A8, A10 and WH6: we replace the pack in our workshop under the normal label-and-return process and test the seal before return.
  9. Total Care month-18 battery serviceWe contact your site contact from month 17 and agree a schedule for the 60-day window centred on month 18. W8 and W10: a new pack for every covered W8 and W10, sent to your site in one consignment by road courier with fitting instructions; old packs go to local battery recycling or are held for end-of-life collection. A6, A8, A10 and WH6: we take a capacity reading of every covered device (the Windows battery report on the WH6, our diagnostic app on the A6, A8 and A10, or through your MDM where you allow it). Every device below 80% is re-batteried in our workshop in batches: we send swap units from the pool for the first batch, you return those devices on the prepaid labels, and the next batch is scheduled once the previous one is re-batteried, resealed and re-imaged. No batch is larger than the swap units available, so a large cohort is worked through the window, or longer by agreement.
  10. No fault found or excluded damage3-Year Warranty: we tell you before charging, then charge £35 for inspection and return carriage and return the device, or you can ask us for a repair quote. Total Care: the first two no-fault returns per contract year are free, then £35 each. Under Total Care, damage is covered under clause 21A; for damage beyond its limits, or not covered by it, we send a fixed-price repair quote within two working days; you either accept it (the swap unit stays with you and the repaired device joins the pool), return the swap unit within ten working days, or buy the swap unit at list less your fleet discount.
  11. Close and recordThe register is updated so the repaired device, or the replacement serial, carries the rest of the original term (or 90 days if longer), and the replaced device or part is marked as our property. The term does not restart. The RMA log records the costs (parts, labour hours, carriage including declared value) and the clock times (logged, accepted, dispatched, delivered, returned) so service credits can be calculated and a repair rate can be published once we have at least 12 months and several hundred devices of history, with the method stated.
  12. Service credit (Total Care only)If the swap unit was delivered to a standard-network address after the delivery level, we add one month of Total Care to that device for each working day of delay, up to three months per incident, confirm it in the claim closure email and show it in the next quarterly fleet report. You do not have to ask. The only exceptions are delays caused at your end (wrong or unattended address, refused delivery), events outside the reasonable control of both of us, and working days of planned absence we notified in advance. Addresses outside the standard network do not carry the credit.
Questions

Warranty questions

No. The included warranty and the 3-Year Warranty are warranties given by the seller, Destello Tech Ltd trading as Tuga Hardware, against defects in materials and workmanship, including the battery. Total Care is a service contract that includes that warranty and adds cover for accidental damage, theft and loss, which we provide ourselves within the fair use limits in clause 21D. No insurer or other third party stands behind any of them, and the remedy is always our own repair, replacement or service, never a cash payment. All of them are in addition to your legal rights and do not reduce them.

A fault in materials or workmanship that stops the device, or a part of it, working as described in its specification. A drop, a cracked screen, liquid inside a sealed port, or a battery that has lost capacity through normal ageing are not defects: the included warranty and the 3-Year Warranty do not cover them, and Total Care covers the damage under clause 21A. The full exclusions are in clause 17 of the Terms, and they are the same list on this page.

Under Total Care, yes: drops, cracked screens, crushing (run over, sat on, trapped), liquid and fire are covered, with no excess and a fair use limit of two claims per device in each contract year, and we send a swap unit the same working day for a claim accepted by 14:00. Under the included warranty and the 3-Year Warranty, no: they cover defects only. If you send a damaged device in under those, we inspect it and tell you what we found before charging anything; you can then pay £35 for inspection and return carriage, or ask us for a repair quote.

Under Total Care we replace it. Report a theft to the police and send us the crime reference number, or tell us in writing where and when a lost device was last seen, within five working days. Lock or wipe it through your device management, or ask us to, and we bar its serial. We then send a replacement of the same model with your image on it, like any other Total Care claim. There is no excess. Fair use allows one theft or loss claim per device over the term, and if a lost device turns up you return either one and the claim no longer counts. A device left on show in an unlocked van, or kept by an employee who leaves, is not covered. The included warranty and the 3-Year Warranty do not cover theft or loss.

It is the published limit on claims for things that happen to a device, so the price stays fair for every fleet: two accidental damage claims per device in each contract year, and one theft or loss claim per device over the 36-month term. Within those limits there is no excess and nothing to pay. Beyond them, we send a fixed-price repair quote for a damaged device, or quote a replacement for a stolen or lost one at list price less your fleet discount, and we never charge without your agreement. Defects, software faults and the month-18 battery service have no limit. The rule is clause 21D of the Plan Terms.

Yes. The built-in scanner on the A6 and on the scanner versions of the W8, W10 and WH6 is covered against defects like every other part, for 12 months as standard and 36 months under either plan. Scanner versions cost £15 more per device on either plan because the scan engine is one more part we may have to repair or replace: the 3-Year Warranty is £94 on the W8 with 2D Scanner and the W10 with 2D Scanner, and £104 on the WH6 with Barcode Scanner. The A6 always has its scanner, and its plan price already includes it.

We compare the battery controller's reported full charge capacity with the rated capacity, read three times across three full charge cycles. On the W8, W10 and WH6 we use the Windows battery report (full charge capacity against design capacity); on the A6, A8 and A10 our diagnostic app reads the charge counter. Under the 3-Year Warranty we use the reading to confirm a battery defect; gradual capacity loss with age and use is normal and is not covered. Under Total Care every A6, A8, A10 and WH6 is read at month 18 and re-batteried in our workshop if below 80%, and every W8 and W10 gets a new pack at month 18 regardless of reading. The method is written into the Terms so the result is not a matter of opinion.

Under Total Care, we do, both ways, on every claim, using the labels in the swap box. Under the included 12-month warranty and the 3-Year Warranty, which work the same way, business buyers pay to send the device to us and we pay the return; if you buy as a consumer and the device is faulty, we pay both ways. A 3-Year Warranty bought before 27 October 2026 keeps carriage paid both ways for its whole term. If we find no defect or an excluded fault we may charge £35 for inspection and return carriage, and we tell you before we charge. W8 and W10 battery packs are sent by road courier; we never ask you to post a battery back.

A working day is Monday to Friday excluding bank holidays in England and Wales. Under Total Care, if we accept your claim by 14:00 on a working day we dispatch a pre-imaged swap unit that day on a next-working-day courier, so it is delivered by the end of the following working day to addresses on the courier's standard next-day network. We check every delivery address by postcode when you join and list the ones on that network in your fleet schedule. Addresses outside it, including Northern Ireland, the Scottish Highlands and Islands, the Isle of Wight and the Isle of Man, get the same-day dispatch on the fastest service available, which typically takes two to five working days, and the service credit does not apply there. Acceptance means we have confirmed the serial is on our register and a remote check of no more than 20 minutes has not cleared the fault. Log the claim by 12:00 with the checklist done and you have our decision by 14:00. A claim accepted after 14:00 counts as accepted at 08:30 the next working day.

If the address is on the standard next-day network, we add one month to the Total Care term of that device for each working day of delay, up to three months per incident, and we apply it without you asking. The exceptions are delays caused at your end (wrong or unattended address, refused delivery), events outside the reasonable control of both of us, such as severe weather or a strike, and working days of planned closure we told you about at least five working days in advance, when we position swap stock or your customer-held spare beforehand. This term extension is the only remedy for a missed service level, and the Terms say so.

The 3-Year Warranty is the included warranty for longer: the same defect cover, carriage and ten-working-day workshop target, for 36 months instead of 12. It suits one device, or a few, where a week in our workshop is a nuisance rather than a crisis. Total Care is the whole package for fleets of five or more: a pre-imaged swap unit dispatched the same working day for any claim accepted by 14:00, with a service credit if it arrives late, plus cover for accidental damage, theft and loss, software restoration, battery service at month 18, a support desk and certified erasure at the end. A 3-Year Warranty bought before 27 October 2026 keeps the five-working-day target and the replacement at ten working days it was sold with.

Within 30 days of dispatch, yes, at the published price and without inspection. From day 31 to the end of month 12 you can add the 3-Year Warranty after a short remote diagnostic check of each device (battery reading and photos), which we may decline. Total Care can be added in that window only for devices joining an existing Total Care fleet. In every case the term runs from the original dispatch date. After month 12 the plans are not available. You do not have to buy a plan with the device, and extended warranties are also available from other providers.

A replacement takes over the plan for the rest of the original term, or 90 days if that is longer; the term does not restart. If you return the device under our 30-day returns policy for business buyers, or cancel a distance purchase within 14 days as a consumer, we refund the plan in full with it. You can cancel either plan within 30 days of purchase for a full refund if you have made no claim (45 days if you buy as a consumer, and we tell you so in your confirmation email). After that the 3-Year Warranty refunds pro rata by full unexpired months; Total Care runs for its fixed 36-month term. Making a claim does not end a plan.

Some of the work in Total Care costs the same for five devices as for fifty: building and testing your image, onboarding your sites and holding at least one swap unit for your fleet. Fleets of 5 to 9 devices pay £30 more per device to cover it (A6 £279, A8 £299, A10 £309, W8 £329, W10 £329, WH6 £359); once your account holds 10 or more Total Care devices, counting the ones you are adding, every device on that quote takes the lower price (A6 £249, A8 £269, A10 £279, W8 £299, W10 £299, WH6 £329). Total Care is available on every Tuga model, and you can mix models in one fleet.

Not at the moment. The 3-Year Warranty and Total Care are one-off prices, and Total Care is paid in advance on a proforma invoice. If you need to spread the cost of a fleet, tell us and we will let you know if a monthly option becomes available.

Information for consumers

If you are buying for yourself rather than a business

Information for consumers, which we are required to give and would give anyway. Extended warranties for electronic devices are available from other providers, and you may wish to compare them. If you are buying for your home, your household insurance may already be relevant to some of the same risks. You do not have to buy a plan at the same time as the device: either plan can be added within 30 days of dispatch at the published price, and the 3-Year Warranty up to the end of month 12 after a remote check. There is no financial protection scheme behind the plans: if Destello Tech Ltd stopped trading, the plans would end. Making a claim does not end a plan; it continues for the rest of its term. Consumers can cancel a plan within 45 days for a full refund if no claim has been made, and your statutory rights under the Consumer Rights Act 2015 and the Consumer Contracts Regulations 2013 are not affected; see clauses 3, 34, 46 and 47 of the Terms.

The full terms are the Plan Terms, which also set out the standard warranty in clauses 44 to 49, and our Terms and Conditions. Nothing on this page replaces them, and nothing in them is different from this page.

Choose the 3-Year Warranty, or ask for Total Care, under Cover on any device page. Business buyers can ask for either plan line by line on a proforma.
